slides.headline: Agents that think in code
slides.say: Stop scrolling... you can run AI agents that write and execute code.

slides.headline: What it does
slides.body: A minimal library for AI agents that write code to solve tasks
slides.say: This tool lets you run AI agents that write Python code to get things done — not just pick tools from a list.

slides.headline: 29,739 GitHub stars
slides.body: Apache-2.0 licence · Written in Python · Since December 2024
slides.say: It has over 20 thousand stars on GitHub and uses the Apache-2.0 licence.

slides.headline: What to know first
slides.body: Local executor is not a security sandbox; use cloud or Docker sandboxes
slides.say: The built-in local code runner is not a security boundary. For untrusted tasks, the README says to use a cloud sandbox or Docker instead.
